short_desc_en: Income support of ₹6,000 per year, paid in three installments, to landholding farmer families.
short_desc_hi: भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को हर साल ₹6,000 की आय सहायता, तीन किस्तों में।
apply_steps: Visit the PM-KISAN portal or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Register with Aadhaar number and land record details.
Submit self-declaration of landholding.
Get e-KYC done and wait for verification by the local revenue officer.

name_en: Ayushman Bharat – PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत – पीएम जन आरोग्य योजना
short_desc_en: Free health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
short_desc_hi: परिवार को प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का निःशुल्क स्वास्थ्य बीमा कवर।
documents: Ration card or SECC household ID
Income certificate (if not in SECC database)
apply_steps: Check eligibility on the PM-JAY website using your ration card or Aadhaar.
Visit the nearest empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre.
Complete e-KYC to generate your Ayushman card.
Use the card for cashless treatment at any empanelled hospital.

short_desc_en: Financial assistance and interest subsidy to help economically weaker and low-income families build or buy a home.
short_desc_hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर और निम्न आय वर्ग के परिवारों को घर बनाने या खरीदने में सहायता।
documents: Proof that applicant or family does not own a pucca house
apply_steps: Check your eligibility category (EWS/LIG/MIG) on the PMAY portal.
Fill the online application with Aadhaar and income details.
Upload supporting documents.
Track application status using your application/Aadhaar number.

short_desc_en: A high-interest savings scheme for the education and marriage expenses of a girl child, opened by a parent or guardian.
short_desc_hi: बालिका की शिक्षा और विवाह के लिए माता-पिता/अभिभावक द्वारा खोली जाने वाली उच्च-ब्याज बचत योजना।
documents: Aadhaar card of girl child and guardian
apply_steps: Visit any post office or authorised bank branch.
Fill the Sukanya Samriddhi account opening form.
Submit documents and deposit the minimum opening amount (₹250).
Continue annual deposits until the girl turns 14, account matures at 21.

name_hi: एससी/एसटी/ओबीसी/अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
short_desc_en: Financial assistance covering tuition, maintenance and other fees for students from SC, ST, OBC or minority communities studying after Class 10.
short_desc_hi: कक्षा 10 के बाद पढ़ाई कर रहे एससी, एसटी, ओबीसी या अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों के लिए ट्यूशन व अन्य शुल्क में सहायता।
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Ministry of Minority Affairs
apply_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Fill in personal, academic and bank details.
Upload caste and income certificates.
Get the application verified by your institution and district authority.

short_desc_en: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh for micro and small business units under Shishu, Kishor and Tarun categories.
short_desc_hi: शिशु, किशोर और तरुण श्रेणियों में सूक्ष्म व लघु उद्यमों के लिए ₹20 लाख तक का बिना गारंटी ऋण।
documents: Business plan or proof of existing business
apply_steps: Prepare a brief business plan and estimate loan requirement.
Approach any nationalised bank, RRB, cooperative bank or NBFC, or apply via udyamimitra.in.
Submit the Mudra loan application with KYC and business documents.
On approval, receive the Mudra Card linked to your loan account.

short_desc_en: A guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60 for workers in the unorganised sector.
short_desc_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों के लिए 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹1,000–₹5,000 की गारंटीशुदा मासिक पेंशन।
documents: Savings bank account or post office savings account
apply_steps: Visit your bank branch or post office where you hold a savings account.
Fill the APY registration form and choose your pension amount.
Set up auto-debit for monthly, quarterly or half-yearly contributions.
Nominate a beneficiary for the pension account.

short_desc_en: Free LPG gas connection with financial support for the first cylinder and stove, for women from low-income households.
short_desc_hi: निम्न आय वर्ग की महिलाओं को पहले सिलेंडर व चूल्हे के लिए सहायता सहित निःशुल्क एलपीजी कनेक्शन।
apply_steps: Visit the nearest LPG distributor (Indane/Bharat Gas/HP Gas) or apply online.
Fill Form KYC for a new PMUY connection.
Submit Aadhaar, address proof and BPL/ration card.
Collect the new connection once verified by the distributor.

short_desc_en: Low-premium crop insurance protecting farmers against crop loss from natural calamities, pests or disease.
short_desc_hi: प्राकृतिक आपदा, कीट या रोग से फसल हानि पर किसानों को कम प्रीमियम पर बीमा सुरक्षा।
apply_steps: Apply through your bank (if you have a crop loan) or visit pmfby.gov.in.
Select the crop and season for which you want cover.
Pay your share of the premium (as low as 1.5–5% of sum insured).
Report crop loss within 72 hours of the event to claim compensation.

short_desc_en: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up a new (greenfield) enterprise, for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
short_desc_hi: एससी/एसटी और महिला उद्यमियों के लिए नया उद्यम शुरू करने हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक ऋण।
documents: Detailed project report for the proposed enterprise
apply_steps: Prepare a project report for your greenfield enterprise idea.
Apply online via standupmitra.in or visit the nearest bank branch.
Submit KYC, caste certificate (if applicable) and project documents.
Attend the bank's appraisal and handholding sessions before disbursal.

short_desc_en: A voluntary pension scheme guaranteeing ₹3,000 per month after age 60 for unorganised sector workers.
short_desc_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों के लिए 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹3,000 प्रति माह की गारंटीशुदा पेंशन।
documents: Savings bank account/Jan Dhan account number with IFSC
apply_steps: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Carry your Aadhaar card and bank passbook.
Complete registration and set your monthly contribution (₹55–₹200 based on age).
Receive your Shram Yogi card after enrolment.

short_desc_en: ₹12,000 per year for meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent dropout at the secondary stage (Class 9–12).
short_desc_hi: आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग के मेधावी छात्रों को कक्षा 9-12 में पढ़ाई जारी रखने हेतु ₹12,000 प्रति वर्ष।
apply_steps: Check if your state is conducting the NMMS selection test this year.
Register through your school or the state education department portal.
Appear for the NMMS selection test (MAT + SAT).
On qualifying, submit income and academic documents for scholarship disbursal.
